_about: Canonical Bedrock model-ID to AWS Price List join map (issue #14). Rows are keyed by the structured tuple (model_id, region, dimension) and store the EXACT structured join fields (usagetype + regionCode, with service_tier/operation as supplementary confirmations). The resolver matches offer rows by structured equality on these fields; it never parses the free-text description or the model display name. See pricing/README.md for the finding, the join method, and the maintenance note. Prices are per 1,000,000 tokens (USD). status=verified rows carry a real usagetype read from the 2026-07-07 bulk offer plus a resolvable source_url and verified_date; status=unverified_pending_join rows are in scope but not yet resolvable (join.usagetype, price_per_1M_usd, verified_date are all null) and must be populated from a signed GetProducts or the dated pricing page.
